mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_invite (uuid, survey_id, email, email_mask, status, create_time, send_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{surveyId}, #{email}, #{emailMask}, #{status}, NOW(), #{sendTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, survey_id AS surveyId, email, email_mask AS emailMask, status, create_time AS createTime, send_time AS sendTime FROM survey_invite WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.update: UPDATE survey_invite SET status = 1, send_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE survey_invite SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
